page: OVHcloud b3-128 is a General Purpose server built on the KVM hypervisor, featuring an AMD EPYC x86_64 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core, alongside 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth interface, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, the b3-128 demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, achieving a stress-ng multi-core score of 98377.64 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 17522.0. Memory performance is highly competitive, with cached read bandwidth reaching 4737.01 GB/sec and uncached large-block write speeds of 145.9 GB/sec. Database performance is a notable highlight, with the server processing 74.67 million Redis SET operations per second and scoring 30713.31 on Passmark database operations. Single-core performance sits in the average tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1867.0.

The dedicated core allocation ensures predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of hyperthreaded environments. This resource density makes the server a highly cost-efficient option for workloads requiring consistent CPU and memory throughput. The b3-128 is best suited for database hosting, Redis deployments, multi-threaded data processing, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
